description: The two notes, and the door

participation.context: Finished the notes, wrote the line, and kept the refusal.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the book is for him after the play, not before

story.body: You wrote the two notes and one prose line, and you kept the plain ending. The book stayed with you until after the play.

relations.note: the book is for him after the play, not before

title: Shut the comedy on one prose line before dinner

participation.context: Read the line back and did not add a song beneath it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the line is the end, and the fee is not today

story.body: The page showed the prose line and no song under it. You left it and went to play.

relations.note: the line is the end, and the fee is not today

title: Left the one line on the leaf

participation.context: Kept the refusal and left the other two debts where they were.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: eight shillings still owing, and not paid

story.body: You did not reopen the ending. You did not pay Edith, and you did not answer the letter.

relations.note: eight shillings still owing, and not paid
